## What is copied

`README.md` and `LICENSE`, unchanged. The README's section "What's Inside Each DESIGN.md" lists the
structure a DESIGN.md follows (theme, colour roles, typography, components, layout, depth, do's and
don'ts, responsive behaviour).

## What is read but not copied

`design-md/ibm/DESIGN.md` at the same commit was read in full as one example of that structure
(front matter of tokens, then prose sections with a hierarchy table, elevation table, do's and
don'ts, breakpoints and known gaps). It is not copied: every file in that folder describes a real
brand's visual identity, and the UI brief says to copy no brand's values. briefstack's
`docs/DESIGN.md` takes the structure only; none of its values come from any file in this repository.
